summary: Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corp filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing that on November 4, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Office of the General Counsel letter confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) for the Nasdaq Global Market. The prior October 14, 2026 Staff letter had flagged non-compliance tied to the missing Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, which the company filed November 2, 2026; the scheduled November 19, 2026 Hearings Panel was cancelled and securities continue trading under SEGG. Watch future filing timeliness as the residual delisting risk.
